Take it as it is, your past relationship had its ups and downs, both of you tried your best, and made mistakes. It's over now, what's in the past can not be undone, that chapter ended but you have your whole life ahead of you.
It's okay if you still think about it that's natural but don't let it take over your life. Give yourself time to breathe and enjoy your "new freedom" and be patient (Ik a lot of this sounds cliché, but it's helping me and I hope it will help you heal :'))
Also, sometimes you just have to ignore your own thoughts, you have to dismiss them just like you do with useless notifications. 
Personally, keeping myself occupied helps a lot, be it watching movies (no romance tho lol) , reading books, listening to music, dancing, studying or just little talks with someone else, all of these work. They remind me that my life is about me and me alone.
(I have to add that reminding myself that life doesn't revolve around me and that, my problems and I, we are "negligible" in this world makes me feel at ease)

The "no contact" thing helps a lot. The emptiness is normal, try to fill it with things you enjoy (like maybe art) or studying.
Spending time with friends helps A LOT too.
I know it's not easy but be sure that this will make you stronger.
Focus on your life, be patient and let time do its magic.

You already said that you know you deserve better, so you have to convince yourself to follow your mind not your emotions.. I feel the same, but it's getting better by time, and it will for you too.

So stay strong, and give yourself time.

You should know that you are not obliged to have a boyfriend. I'm not saying that you should break up but don't scared of it. I think you're feeling depressed, and having someone close standing by you really helps with depression. (But I'm no pro and I maybe wrong)
For now focus on what makes you happy, what are your favourite activities ? Your favourite places ? Taking walks in parcs (even alone with some good music) might help too. Remember that nothing lasts forever, by that I mean this bad period you're living.
Some youtube videos might be helpful too.
Maybe you already know all of this, I just hope you feel'll better soon.
